NERAMAC Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NERAMAC Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the NERAMAC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the NERAMAC recruitment is Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer post in NERAMAC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B. Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST (up to 40 years) and OBC/MOBC (up to 38 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of up to Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to appear for a Walk-in Interview with their bio-data and relevant certificates. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date and venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held on 21-09-2026 at NERAMAC, Guwahati, Assam, 781019.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their full Bio-data, necessary educational and experience certificates in original, and self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Assistant Manager – Civil Engineer position at NERAMAC.
